# UX and Accessibility Checklist: Guided Migration

**Purpose**: Check that the guided flow requirements are complete, clear, and consistent for UX and accessibility, before `/speckit-tasks`.
**Created**: 2026-11-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the layout of one checklist row specified (order of tick box, name, open-in-other-app icon, Skip, state look)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the visual difference between open, ticked, and skipped rows specified beyond "look different"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the "easy to find" highlight of the row the user just opened defined (what it looks like, how long it stays)? [Ambiguity, Spec §US2-2]
- [ ] CHK004 Is an empty-search-result state defined for the checklist search box? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the search matching rule defined (name only, case, accents, partial text)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the Twitch waiting state, cancel path, and expired-code message defined for sign-in? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, §US1-6]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the Start again control's place and label specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-017, §US3-2]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the "working" indicator for large files specified (progress, cancel)? [Ambiguity, Spec §US1-5]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "a rough time" in the intro defined as a number or range per platform, and where it comes from? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "the steps match the platform's current screens" measurable, and is there an owner and review period for keeping it true? [Measurability, Spec §US1-2, §US4]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "smooth" scrolling in US2-7 backed by the measurable target in SC-004 for the same list sizes? [Consistency, Spec §US2-7, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "tick shows within half a second" defined for the slowest supported device and storage state? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "first try" in SC-006 defined (what counts as the right file, how it is observed)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do the Continue note rules in FR-019 and US3-1 agree on what the count means (open rows vs ticked and skipped)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-019, §US3-1]
- [ ] CHK015 Does US3-1 "the checklist keeps every tick and skip" agree with the Keep list and Clear list rules in FR-026 and US2-6? [Consistency, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the progress bar count (ticked and skipped against total) match the count shown on Home? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK017 Do the Twitch rules agree: FR-004 says no export steps, the intro (FR-003) says the app never signs in to the user's social accounts, and FR-008 has a Twitch sign-in? [Conflict, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the order of the four flow parts in FR-002 consistent with the screen diagram, where Home can open the checklist directly? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §Diagram]

## Accessibility

- [ ] CHK019 Are screen reader labels defined for each row (name, state, and what each control does)? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the progress bar's accessible value defined (for example "34 of 120")? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the state shown by more than color (icon or text), for color-blind users? [Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK022 Are tap target sizes defined for the name link, the tick box, and Skip so they cannot be hit by mistake? [Gap, Spec §US2-3]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for pictures in guide steps (text alternative for each step picture)? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for a second export picked while a list already exists (replace, merge, refuse)? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for the user switching to the other app and not coming back, then returning much later with the app closed by the system? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 Are recovery requirements defined when saving a tick fails (what the row shows, whether the user can retry)? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Is behavior defined for names with right-to-left text, emoji, or very long handles in a row? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK028 Are layout requirements defined for tablets, folding phones, and landscape? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 Is the assumption that every export includes enough data to build a profile link tied to a per-platform check before the platform shows on Home? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the assumption that the user is signed in to the new account in the other app backed by a requirement for what happens when they are not (the profile shows a login page)? [Assumption, Spec §FR-014]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers
